entities.name: Aušra Augustinavičiūtė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aušra Augustinavičiūtė was a Lithuanian psychologist, economist and dean of the Vilnius Pedagogical University's department of family science. She was the founder of socionics, the theory of information processing and personality types.
